# Stephan's Pet Store & Grooming Studio

> Tanzania's premier pet care destination with physical stores in Dar es Salaam and nationwide delivery across Tanzania.

## Overview
Stephan's Pet Store is a premier pet retail, nutrition, and professional grooming company based in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania. We specialize in high-grade veterinary and premium dog and cat food, hygiene essentials, accessories, and stress-free grooming care.

## Physical Stores & Contact Information
### 1. Masaki Flagship Store & Grooming Studio
- **Address**: 11 Slipway Road, Masaki, Dar es Salaam, Tanzania (near The Slipway Waterfront)
- **Coordinates**: -6.7452, 39.2825
- **Phone**: +255 786 627 873
- **WhatsApp**: https://wa.me/255786627873
- **Opening Hours**: Monday – Saturday: 9:00 AM – 8:30 PM | Sunday: Closed
- **Services**: Full Pet Shop, Professional Dog & Cat Grooming Studio, Nutrition Consulting, Same-Day Dar Delivery
- **URL**: https://www.stephanspetstore.co.tz/stores/masaki

## Core Services & Products
- **Professional Pet Grooming**: Full wash, hypoallergenic bathing, styling, de-shedding, dematting, sanitary trim, nail clip, ear cleaning at our Masaki studio. Online slot booking: https://www.stephanspetstore.co.tz/grooming.
- **Flagship Pet Food Brands**: Summit 10, Bioline, Josera, Bravecto, Royal Canin, TropiDog, TropiCat.
- **Pet Accessories**: Beds, collars, leashes, harnesses, scratching posts, litter boxes, toys, bowls, travel crates.
- **Delivery Service**: Same-day delivery across all Dar es Salaam neighborhoods (free for orders above TSh 100,000). Express parcel courier delivery across Tanzania (Arusha, Dodoma, Mwanza, Morogoro, Zanzibar).
- **Payment Methods**: Selcom Mobile Money (M-Pesa, Airtel Money, Mixx by Yas, Halopesa), Visa/Mastercard, Sky Wallet store rewards, and Cash on Delivery.
